info.name: MediTrack - Frontend Routes & Client API Collection
info.description: Complete Postman collection for the MediTrack Frontend Application. Contains every Single Frontend Page & Client Route (React Router v6 in Vite at http://localhost:5173), along with every Frontend API Service Client Endpoint (api.js layer) mapped to the backend.

variable.description: JWT Access Token stored in localStorage

request.description: Public landing page (`/`). Features system overview, features, and call-to-actions.
Login page (`/login`). User enters email and password.
Registration page (`/signup`). User inputs name, email, password, and selects role.
Main dashboard (`/dashboard`). Shows today's schedule, pending doses, adherence score, and current streak.
Medication history view (`/medication-history`). Shows past taken, late, and missed dose logs.
Add new medication form (`/add-medication`). Input dosage, frequency, times, dates.
Weekly and daily calendar medication schedule (`/schedule`).
Adherence charts, progress metrics, and compliance score (`/adherence`).
Patient chat page (`/chat`) to message linked caregiver or doctor.
User personal profile and account settings (`/profile`).
Notifications center (`/notifications`). View and mark alerts.
Doctor's view of an individual patient's records (`/patient/:patientId`).
Doctor patient adherence alerts and missed dose flags (`/alerts`).
List of all patients monitored by the caregiver (`/caregiver/patients`).
Caregiver adherence alerts and critical missed dose warnings (`/caregiver/alerts`).
Caregiver patient compliance and adherence reports (`/caregiver/reports`).
Caregiver profile and notifications preference settings (`/caregiver/profile`).
System admin metrics and system overview (`/admin/dashboard`).
Admin user list, role management, and accounts (`/admin/users`).
Global adherence analytics and platform statistics (`/admin/analytics`).
Frontend login API call: saves tokens in localStorage.
Frontend logout API call: clears localStorage and revokes refreshToken.
Frontend automatic 401 interceptor token refresh call.
Frontend custom date range adherence chart.
Frontend caregiver patient weekly report view.
